::: {style="text-align:center"}
## The World's Tallest Tree
:::

![](https://irp.cdn-website.com/4ef20bc3/dms3rep/multi/IMG_0587.jpg)

###### **Pictured above is the world's tallest tree, *Sequoia sepervirens*. It is only found on the western coast of the U.S. in very small populations. Conservation of its limited habitat is extremely critical.**
